target_industries.name: target_industries
target_industries.default: '["Local construction companies","Independent insurance agencies","Boutique marketing firms"]'::jsonb

association_scan_job_kind_inputs.name: association_scan_job_kind_inputs
association_scan_job_kind_inputs.value: ("association_scan_jobs"."kind" = 'website_scan' and "association_scan_jobs"."prospect_id" is not null and "association_scan_jobs"."source_state" is null) or ("association_scan_jobs"."kind" = 'irs_sample' and "association_scan_jobs"."prospect_id" is null and "association_scan_jobs"."source_state" is not null and "association_scan_jobs"."sample_limit" between 5 and 25)

pricing_range_valid.name: pricing_range_valid
pricing_range_valid.value: ("pricing_entries"."range_min_cents" IS NULL AND "pricing_entries"."range_max_cents" IS NULL) OR ("pricing_entries"."range_min_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "pricing_entries"."range_max_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "pricing_entries"."range_min_cents" >= 0 AND "pricing_entries"."range_max_cents" >= "pricing_entries"."range_min_cents" AND "pricing_entries"."amount_cents" IS NULL)
